name: remotion-skill-examples
description: Nine finished compositions built with the remotion-motion-graphics skill

scripts.audio: node scripts/gen-sfx.mjs && node scripts/gen-track.mjs && node scripts/gen-kl.mjs && node scripts/gen-my.mjs && node scripts/gen-neon.mjs && node scripts/gen-kedai.mjs
scripts.render:profile: remotion render src/index.ts HaidrrrryPromo out/profile-promo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:focuscat: remotion render src/index.ts FocusCatPromo out/focus-cat-promo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:selffix: remotion render src/index.ts SelfFix out/self-fix.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:codeedit: remotion render src/index.ts CodeEdit out/code-edit.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:kl: remotion render src/index.ts KLNight out/kl-night.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:tanahairku: remotion render src/index.ts TanahAirku out/tanah-airku.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:neon: remotion render src/index.ts MalaysiaNeon out/malaysia-neon.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:kedai: remotion render src/index.ts KedaiLaunch out/kedai-launch.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:kerja: remotion render src/index.ts KerjaMakanGajiVsKerjaSendiri out/kerja-makan-gaji-vs-kerja-sendiri.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
